_comment: EXAMPLE — copy to $CLAUDE_TRIAGE_DIR/daemon.config.json and replace __PROJECT_ROOT__ with your project path (add more projects as needed). NOTE: per-project routing (repos/branches/labels) lives in <project>/.claude/auto-triage.config.json, NOT here — so this file carries no repo names. budget gates on the live 5h rolling-window %; the daemon fans out one `claude -p /triage <ticket>` per claimable ticket.

models._comment: Right model per phase. `orchestrator` runs the cheap mechanical polls that fire EVERY tick for EVERY project regardless of ticket volume — `/triage --list` (discovery), `/triage-cleanup` (reaper), `/triage-block` (mark) — so it dominates idle cost; keep it small. `write` runs `/triage <ID>` (route + plan-with-docs + TDD implement + gates + verifier — its subagents inherit this model), so it carries the real engineering: keep it strong. Aliases track the latest of each tier (opus→4.8, haiku→4.5). A project may override `write` with its own `model` key below.

budget._comment: Primary budget is USAGE (subscription): hold new work when the live 5h rolling-window is >= maxFiveHourPercent. The *MaxUsd values are NOT the budget — they're per-run runaway safety caps (Claude Code's only native per-call limit is --max-budget-usd); sized generously so cold-start cache cost can't false-trip them.

reaper._comment: maxAttempts caps retries of the SAME ticket: after this many runs die on it without producing a PR or plan, the reaper parks it (triage-blocked + one comment) instead of re-queuing it forever — which is what produced repeated 'returning to queue for retry' notifications.

projects.name: myproject
projects._model: OPTIONAL per-project override of models.write (the `/triage <ID>` engineering model). Omit to inherit models.write.
